texts.zh: 在拆解了C.A.R.E交互界面之后，我们的探险队员有了一个惊人的发现。尽管此人工智能的大多数机械在背水一战之后已经毁于一旦，但是我们的队员成功寻回了一个不同寻常的电脑芯片，在我们的技术员手里，它一定能发挥出不俗的价值。
texts.en: After disassembling the C.A.R.E Interactive Interface, our expedition crew made an incredible discovery. While most of the AI's machinery was destroyed in the firefight with its last-ditch effort defenses, our crew has managed to recover a remarkable computer chip that should be of value to our technicians.
